        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.11.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_slow value = 1 } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -5 } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = 5 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_12 value = oe_y7_hi_11 } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_job value = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y7.20 }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_y7.11.e
        trigger = { oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no }
        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.11.e.tt
        hidden_effect = { oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -5 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
}

# CHI scope. Due 3 months after .11 a, or at S+48 after .11 b; Toqto'a in charge (dropped otherwise). AI weight of a = oe_y7_dismiss_w (35-90, stored in CHI var oe_y7_dw when the event is sent), b = 100 - a.
oe_y7.12 = { # 罢相诏
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    title = oe_y7.12.t
    desc = oe_y7.12.d
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior 10 = angry }
    trigger = { tag = CHI oe_y7_can_12 = yes }
    immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 } global_var:oe_y7_opp2 = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_o } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_y7.12.a
        historical_option = yes
        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.12.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_y7_job value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y7.20 }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 40 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 45 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 50 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 55 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 60 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 65 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 70 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 75 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 80 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 85 } modifier = { add = 5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 90 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_y7.12.b
        add_stability = stability_mild_penalty add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_penalty
        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.12.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_y7_job value = 13 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y7.20 }
        ai_chance = { base = 65 modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 40 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 45 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 50 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 55 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 60 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 65 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 70 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 75 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 80 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 85 } modifier = { add = -5 var:oe_y7_dw >= 90 } }
    }
}

# CHI scope. After .12 b: due once campaign 2 is won (target controlled, enemy gone or come over) or its longer deadline passed. A failure re-rolls the edict with the dismissal weight +20.
oe_y7.13 = { # 高邮之役：结局
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    title = oe_y7.13.t
    desc = { first_valid = { triggered_desc = { trigger = { global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 1 exists = scope:oe_y7_o } desc = oe_y7.13.d1 } triggered_desc = { trigger = { global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 1 } desc = oe_y7.13.d2 } desc = oe_y7.13.d } }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }

    immediate = {
        event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }

    }
    option = {
        name = oe_y7.13.a
        trigger = { global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 1 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.13.a.tt

        name = oe_y7.13.c
        trigger = { NOT = { global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 1 } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_y7.13.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_y7_job value = 16 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_y7.20 }
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }

# Hidden worker, fired from options (CHI) with the country var oe_y7_job: heavy work stays out of option previews.
oe_y7.20 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_y7.20.t
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_y7_job }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 1 } oe_y7_job_dismiss = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 2 } oe_y7_job_seat2 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 3 } oe_y7_job_tammachi = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 4 } oe_y7_job_touxia = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 5 } oe_y7_job_militia = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 6 } oe_y7_job_xuzhou_a = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 7 } oe_y7_job_xuzhou_b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 8 } oe_y7_job_massacre = yes oe_y7_job_xuzhou_won = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 9 } oe_y7_job_xuzhou_won = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 10 } oe_y7_job_amnesty = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 11 } oe_y7_job_gaoyou = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 12 } oe_y7_job_slow = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 13 } oe_y7_job_keep = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 14 } oe_y7_job_gaoyou_take = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 15 } oe_y7_job_gaoyou_pardon = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 16 } oe_y7_job_reroll = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 17 } oe_y7_job_seal = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_y7_job = 18 } oe_y7_job_return = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_y7_job
    }
}
